title: Account activity reads for active runtimes

effect.user: Account activity reports skip pending work reads whose result cannot affect a booting/running classification.
assertions: Active/recent/pending counts, ongoing units and observed claim IDs remain exact.
Inactive pending work, transfer generation ownership, fresh reads and reopen remain supported.
